title: 105 Pelican Circle | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Gulf Front Location In Seacrest Beach Featuring Breathtaking Panoramic Views, Private Beach, and Private Access!
description_expanded: Description: 105 Pelican Circle by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 105 Pelican Circle Details: Welcome to105 Pelican Circle, a beautiful Gulf front home located in Seacrest Beach! This updated quintessential beach house is full of charm and unbeatable views. Guests looking to be right on the beach will fall in love with this location featuring private beachfront access and plenty of space to entertain. Enjoy the privacy within this upscale gated community and gated property. Simply relax and watch the sun set over the Gulf of Mexico from expansive deck with ample outdoor seating. Or put your toes in white sand beaches of the Emerald Coast and walk along the stunning private community beach. This home is ideal for two small families, couples, or a girlfriend getaway. Be sure to grab your bike and jump on Timpoochee trail toward the The Big Chill (formerly The Hub), Alys Beach, or Rosemary Beaches where there is a host of activities, entertainment, boutiques, and dining options. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front -Parking Spaces: 2 -Dining Accommodations: 8 at Dining Table - 6 at Bar -Panoramic Gulf Views -Abundance of outdoor space and seating Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 4 Bedrooms / 3 Full Baths One Floor: -Guest Room 1: King Bed with Private Bath -Guest Room 2: Queen Bed with Shared Bath -Guest Room 3: Queen Bed with Shared Bath -Guest Room 4: Two Queen Beds Private Detached Bath -Kitchen / Living / Dining / Bonus Bed Alcove (Full)/Outdoor Living Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
